system.description:
You warp the thoughts of another creature to give it a flattering impression of you.

Choose a thinking creature within 10 spaces. They must make an opposed Willpower check or be charmed by you for 1 minute. If the creature is currently hostile to you, it has Advantage on this check.

While affected by this spell, the creature treats you as a good and trusted friend. You cannot command the creature to do anything it does not wish to do, but it will not attack you, and will treat any requests you make especially favorably.

Any time the creature takes Damage, it may make another Willpower check to shake off the effect of the spell.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 minutes.
